product.title: BG by BEDGEAR Complete Bedding Set
product.descriptionHtml:
Available as a 5-piece or 8-piece set, our BG by BEDGEAR Bundle has all the bedding essentials you need to set up your new mattress: pillows, pillow protectors, and a sheet set.

Features

  • A Pillow Made for Recovery - Designed for rest and recovery, this pillow provides a comfortable night's sleep.
  • Built for Protection - Made from soft, flexible fabric, our pillow protector guards against common allergens for a clean and healthy sleep.
  • Let's Talk Sheets - This exceptionally soft sheet set includes pillowcases, fitted sheet, and flat sheet, so you can outfit your bed with ease.
  • 5 Piece Set - Available in Twin and Twin XL, includes 1 pillow, 1 pillow protector, and a sheet set with 1 pillowcase.
  • 8 Piece Set - Available in Full, Queen, King, and Cal King, includes 2 pillow, 2 pillow protectors, and a sheet set with 2 pillowcases.
